points.description: States that the collision domain diameter decreases (gets smaller) when the speed is increased.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it is affected/changes or gives the wrong magnitude but correct direction is clear.

points.description: States that it decreases by a factor of 10 (e.g. about 300 m to about 30 m).
points.partial_credit: Half if a reduction is given with a vague or approximate amount (e.g. 'much smaller') without the factor of 10.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the direction (decrease) and the size (factor of 10, example 300 m to 30 m is optional). Give part marks if only the decrease is stated or the amount is vague. Give no marks for saying it increases or stays the same.
